text:
Lena (Eng Manager): Heads up: new senior infra hire starts next Tue. Can we get a tight, copy-paste friendly manager checklist (prestart + week1) and a 30/60/90 focused on outcomes? Need exact people to ping for access.
Ivy (People Ops): @Lena — made a "Manager Quickstart" below. Ill also upload the calendar templates and create the Slack intro.
Ivy (People Ops): PRE-START (48-72h):
- Confirm shipping address & OS preference with IT.
- Provision SSO account and add to infra/team Slack channels.
- Assign buddy + book first-week pairing blocks.
- Share first-week reading pack (design docs + runbook overview).
Ivy (People Ops): WEEK 1 (day-by-day):
Mon: 10m team welcome in #team, 45m 1:1 (expectations + goals), 30m infra tour (high-level arch).
Tue: 2h dev setup + keys (mentor + IT), 30m security & compliance primer.
Wed: 1h runbooks + incident playbooks walkthrough, 1h pair on a safe onboarding task (deploy a test job).
Thu: 1:1 to sketch 30/60/90 (30m), meet with product & platform leads (30m).
Fri: demo small onboarding task, sync + feedback, confirm training completions.
Ivy (People Ops): 30/60/90 (metrics-first, two-line examples you can adapt):
- 30d: "Complete all access & env setup; ship 2 small PRs fixing flaky e2e tests; finish security training."
- 60d: "Take ownership of one infra component; reduce median job startup latency by X% (or draft plan); own oncall shadowing."
- 90d: "Deliver measurable improvement (latency/cost/reliability) and present plan for next quarter; mentor a junior on the team."
Ivy (People Ops): Manager playbook bullets: schedule daily 15m async check-ins first week, protect 3h/week of deep work for them, give a single clear first ownership area, and set feedback points at 2 and 4 weeks.
Lena (Eng Manager): Nice. Who exactly do I ping for repo/Jira/GCP/Github org access?
Ravi (IT): Ping me for laptop + imaging (ravi@). For repo/org/Jira/GCP access, open a ticket with the exact repo/team names — we need org: "redwood-inference", team: "inference-runtime". I can expedite if you include the new hire email.
Ravi (IT): Example ticket body to paste into IT portal:
```
Title: Access request for new hire (name)
Body: New hire <name> starting <date>. Needs: GitHub org: redwood-inference, team: inference-runtime; GCP project: redwood-prod (dev access); Jira groups: inference-eng. Please provision SSH key + add to Slack channels.
Priority: High (onboarding)
```
Diego (HR): I'll send benefits + payroll links. Reminder: submit I-9 & tax forms before day 7. Also book a benefits intro with me in week1 if they want.
Maya (Buddy): I can run the env pairing Tue & Wed afternoons. Ill pre-seed a demo issue they can complete in the first week.
onboard-bot: Created folder: https://redwood.internal/onboarding/manager-quickstart and added calendar templates + 30-60-90 doc.
Lena (Eng Manager): Any recommended reading specific to serving runtime?
Ivy (People Ops): Share these: /learning/serving-runtime-overview, /runbooks/kv-cache-guide, and the "Observability for inference" doc. Ill tag them in the welcome packet.
Lena (Eng Manager): Can we make the 30/60/90 a shared doc I can edit and share with skip-level?
Ivy (People Ops): Done. I created a draft and shared edit rights with you and your manager.
Ravi (IT): One more: does the new hire want a dongle kit or single USB-C? Please confirm.
Lena (Eng Manager): confirming dongle kit. Sending shipping address in DM.
Diego (HR): Sample Slack blurb you can copy for #general on day1:
"Please welcome Jordan Park, joining as Senior Infra Engineer on the Inference team. Jordan will help reduce job startup time and improve reliability. Slack hi + favorite coffee recs encouraged!"
Maya (Buddy): Also I'll send a short "First-week checklist" DM to Jordan with links to runbooks and the demo issue.
Lena (Eng Manager): This is perfect and tight. Thanks everyone :rocket:
